title: Partner Rental Program: Direct-Bill Car Classes and Authorization Terms for Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
Under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, Cardinal reserves and pays the rental directly with a partner agency. This direct billing is available on every option. The car class Cardinal reserves under direct billing at the option's daily limit depends on the option.

## Car class reserved under direct billing

| Option | Direct billing available | Car class Cardinal reserves |
|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 30/900 | Yes | Economy |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200 | Yes | Compact |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 | Yes | Intermediate |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800 | Yes | Standard |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 75/2250 | Yes | Full-size |
| Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 100/3000 | Yes | Standard SUV |

## Authorization terms common to all six options

| Term | Value on every option |
|---|---|
| Rental days authorized when a rental is first set up (initial authorization days) | 7 |
| Days added by one extension | 5 |
| An extension needs the repair shop's confirmation of a new completion date | Yes |
| A documented parts delay justifies an extension within the per-loss limits | Yes |
| Hours within which a direct-bill reservation must be picked up before it lapses | 72 |
| A rental can be authorized only on a reported claim | Yes |
| The customer must be told before pickup which charges will be theirs | Yes |
| The customer pays the difference for a car above the authorized class | Yes |
| A rental picked up outside the policy state is covered | Yes |

## Notes on the terms

- **Reservation lapse.** A direct-bill reservation not picked up within 72 hours lapses.
- **Larger car.** On every option, the customer pays the difference for a car above the class in the first table.
- **Reported claim.** On every option, no rental is authorized without a reported claim.

## Example (hypothetical)

A customer holding Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 50/1500 is offered a direct-bill reservation. The class Cardinal reserves is intermediate. If the customer prefers a full-size car, the difference for the larger class is the customer's to pay. A reservation made on a Monday at 9:00 and not collected by Thursday at 9:00 has passed the 72-hour pickup window and lapses.
